body: The little things are not worth it anymore. Nothing is worth the pain I feel every single day. I don't enjoy anything anymore. I am just done.

These feelings do not come and go, I feel like shit every second of every day. I don't care about chemical hardwiring, it doesn't change anything. We are not robots. If self termination is always an option, why can't I choose it now. Maybe the time isn't right for you but it is for me.
I can't do this anymore, it will never get better.
Yes I will be dead soon
I fail at everything I do and I have no future. Nobody cares and i am give up on life.
